youtube_subtitle_download_command.content:
Command to download only English subtitles (.srt) for a YouTube playlist or video without downloading video/audio:

```powershell
yt-dlp --write-sub --write-auto-sub --sub-lang "en,en-orig,en-US,en-GB" --sub-format srt --convert-subs srt --skip-download -o "%(playlist_index)02d - %(title)s.%(ext)s" "<PLAYLIST_OR_VIDEO_URL>"
```

Key flags:
- `--write-sub`: Downloads human-made English subtitles if available.
- `--write-auto-sub`: Falls back to YouTube's auto-generated English subtitles if manual ones are missing.
- `--sub-lang "en,en-orig,en-US,en-GB"`: Downloads English subtitle tracks.
- `--sub-format srt --convert-subs srt`: Formats/converts subtitles to standard `.srt`.
- `--skip-download`: Skips downloading the video and audio streams.
- `-o "%(playlist_index)02d - %(title)s.%(ext)s"`: Formats the filenames with leading zero playlist numbering and video title.
